input.summary: Ported stencil_1d.cu to SYCL 2020 in stencil_1d.dp.cpp (work dir). The port uses no dpct helpers, DPCT macros, or dpct includes (the only "dpct" match is in a comment I wrote). It compiles with icpx -fsycl without the dpct include path. The kernel is a 1-D nd_range<1> with BLOCK_SIZE=256 work-items, a sycl::local_accessor<int,1> tile of 270 ints (BLOCK_SIZE + 2*RADIUS), the same halo loads, and sycl::group_barrier(item.get_group()) in place of __syncthreads. Memory uses sycl::malloc_device/sycl::free with an in-order queue. Verification: I built an independent CPU reference (out[g] = sum over offsets -7..7 of a[g+o], with a[j]=j and zero for negative indices) and compared it element by element to the candidate's float64 output. Lengths 1048576 and 256 both gave 0 mismatches, so the result matches exactly under atol=0, rtol=0.
